utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Around 7:30 should be fine. I’ll text if I’m running a little late.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to carpool, but I’d want to sort out the timing and pickup order first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so can you confirm what time you’d want to leave and who you’d pick up first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to leave around 7:30 so we have a little cushion, and I’d pick up you first, then Sam on the way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—carpool, right. What time were we meeting again?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, I think it was around 7:30? Sorry, I’m a little fuzzy—want me to double-check?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please do—I might be mixing it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the carpool details and let you know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Just let me know once you’ve got the carpool details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check the carpool details and get back to you with the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late—are we still on for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, we’re still on. I’m ready when you are—just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect—give me five minutes and I’ll head out. I'll text you when I’m downstairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we leaving, and who’s picking up whom?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can grab Maya and you can swing by Sam—let’s leave at 7:30 so we’ve got a little cushion.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — I’ll pick up Sam and head out at 7:30. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, we’re still on for tomorrow. What time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you pick me up at 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal — I can help line up the carpool. What days and times are we trying to cover?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’m still gathering the exact days and times, but I’ll send them over as soon as I have the full schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — send it over when you have it, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I’m thinking weekday mornings, around 7:30 to 8:00, and possibly pickup in the afternoons too. I’ll send you a simple schedule so we can see what works best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Rosa — send it over and I’ll look for the mornings that fit, and I can let you know about afternoons too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies list for the carpool. Just tell me who’s riding with us and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll send you the rider list and what’s left to grab.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — send it over when you can, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s still on for tomorrow, and I think we’ve got one extra seat if you need it. Want me to check the pickup time for you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess—that’d be really helpful. If you can check the pickup time, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll check the pickup time and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the carpool details—who’s riding and what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I’ll send you the rider list and pickup time in a moment.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll wait for that before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what time are we carpooling?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do 7:30, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 7:30 works for me — see you then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others we’re set for the carpool and keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Vik — I really appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep everyone updated and let you know if anything shifts with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—carpool. I think it’s still the same plan, unless something changed and I missed it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I think it’s still the same. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just ping me if it changes and I’ll try not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — could you do 7:30 tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, 7:30 works for me. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m happy to help coordinate the carpool. What days and times are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’m thinking weekdays around 8:00 AM pickup and 5:30 PM drop-off, ideally starting next Monday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works for me, Opal — I’ll start building the weekday carpool around 8:00 AM pickup and 5:30 PM drop-off beginning next Monday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing—who’s picking up whom, and what time should everyone be ready?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can text everyone now and lock it in: I’ll pick up Sam and you can grab Nina, and let’s all be ready by 7:20.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—I'll grab Nina and be ready by 7:20. If anyone runs late, please text me right away so I can adjust.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still doing the carpool at the same time?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet—let me check the time and confirm with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — please let me know once you’ve confirmed the time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear carpool plan, please—who’s driving, what time, and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can drive this round, and I’ll be there at 7:15 at the corner by the mailboxes. If that works, I’ll text when I’m leaving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, thanks. I’ll be waiting by the mailboxes at 7:15 and will watch for your text.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest, but I can ask around and let you know what I find about the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’d appreciate that. I’m keeping an eye on the carpool supplies, so let me know what you hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll check around and come back with whatever I hear about the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — the carpool. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help figure it out with you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — that’d be great. Let’s figure out the pickup times and who’s driving so we can keep it simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, let’s keep it simple. If you tell me the pickup times, I can help sort out who drives which days.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo — I can coordinate the carpool around school drop-off and pickup. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. I’m thinking weekdays for school drop-off around 8:00 and pickup around 3:15, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me most weekdays — I can do 8:00 drop-off and 3:15 pickup. Which days do you want to lock in?
